operations.use_for: Admin, SaaS workspace, dashboards, internal tools
operations.priority: Complete repeated tasks and scan operational state
regions: Detail or edit surface when needed
components: Sidebar, Tabs, Badge, RHF wrappers, Panel overlays
operations.visual: Compact readable hierarchy; existing semantic status tokens; avoid decorative hero sections in the work area
operations.responsive: Keep identity and primary action visible; wrap filters; constrain table overflow within its region
checks: Loading, empty and filtered no-results differ

marketing.use_for: Landing, service business, campaign, SaaS acquisition, pricing
marketing.priority: Explain the offer and support a clear next step
marketing.visual: Brand-led typography, imagery and section rhythm; preserve token-based controls; allow expressive composition when requested
marketing.responsive: Stack sections by reading order; scale headline and media; keep CTA readable without clipping
checks: No invented testimonials, metrics or claims
Long copy and image loading layout

commerce.use_for: Storefront, catalog, product detail, cart and checkout
commerce.priority: Find, compare and purchase with clear cost and state
commerce.visual: Product media and pricing hierarchy; consistent actionable controls; no artificial scarcity
commerce.responsive: Keep product identity, total and purchase action visible; make variant selection usable on narrow screens
checks: Pending/failure retains selections; prevent duplicate mutation

content.use_for: Documentation, help, editorial, blog, learning resources
content.visual: Readable measure and heading hierarchy; use existing typography; avoid boxing each paragraph
content.responsive: Article reflows; code/table overflow stays local; navigation remains reachable
checks: Long code, tables and translated copy

portfolio.use_for: Personal website, creative portfolio, studio case studies
components: Dialog only when an overlay serves the task
portfolio.visual: Allow distinctive art direction and imagery; consistent navigation and controls; derive style from supplied work
portfolio.responsive: Reflow project layouts and keep media aspect ratio stable; touch users can access hover content
